item.title: The Only Scarce Resource Is Time
item.description: Reflecting on the signals sent by the body due to allergies, this piece re-examines the relationship between money and time, contemplating what the only truly scarce resource in life really is.

item.title: Observing the Chain Reaction of My Parents' Emotions
item.description: A reflection on understanding parental emotions, the underlying vulnerability beneath displays of anger, and learning to establish healthy emotional boundaries.
